payload.title: M11 Wave 0: pilot c1/01-05 with the student, plus G13 guardian report
payload.description: Part of M11 (SIE-e8c918); epics cannot nest, so this wave sits beside it and relates-to it. Riskiest wave: the cards may feel babyish. Test: does the student choose Next lesson unprompted. Scope: pilot lessons 01-05 (SIE-93b32f) and G13. Rule: rewrite a lesson if more than 20 percent of goals need rung 3 or Show me. Plan: docs/curriculum-next.md.
